style.register: 游戏指南体，简体中文，简洁直陈，不用敬语，不用『您』。
style.numbers: 数字、百分比、游戏内数值原样保留（如 10%、+5%）。
style.placeholders: ⟦0⟧ ⟦1⟧ 等占位符必须原样保留且不得增删、不得调换顺序；它们代表图标或链接。
style.markup: 不要输出 HTML 标签；保留原文的换行与项目符号结构。
style.properNouns: 国家、人物、舰名等专有名词使用通用中文译名（如 German Reich → 德意志国，Adolf Hitler → 阿道夫·希特勒）；Paradox 未汉化的专有名词可保留英文并加中文注释。
style.consistency: 同一英文术语在全站必须使用同一译名。

Easy and quick with Chile or Argentina. Use the research bonuses from the military branch of the focus tree to get nuclear weapons early. As Chile you need some fighters to guarantee air superiority. As Argentina just release Y Wladychfa Gymreig as a free country and then justify a war goal.
I'm Home!As Brazil occupy every core of Portugal
Controls: Porto (180) Guarda (181) Lisbon (112) Santarém (795) Beja (179) Madeira (697) Azores (698)

You can start this by either subjugating Portugal with the monarchist path, or by going down communism or fascism, getting a foothold in Iberia by declaring on one (or more) of the Spanish Civil War factions, and taking land when they capitulate that borders Portugal. If you subjugate them, it's easier if you take Spain and give it to your Portugese puppet so you can build on the land and lower their autonomy easier.

Somehow He Has ReturnedAs Argentina, have Señor Hilter become country leader

Play historical. Go down the fascist route, build fascist support until you can take Guardia Nacional, then wait until Germany has capitulated. The event will fire soon after. No other condition is necessary, you can be at war with Germany yourself, and as getting Señor Hilter in power is the first option in the event, it should select itself if you prefer to be afk the entire time.
